tuning: none; full updates, future, p=2/3 fixed for both rules

references.names: Reuse archived her_full and er_episodic through experiments/grid/agent_names.json; never rerun reference grids.

analysis.primary: Equally weighted mean over registered points within a seed, then mean and SE over seeds 42--61.
analysis.final: Last registered nominal point within each seed, then mean and SE over seeds 42--61.
analysis.paired_interval: Paired seed differences; marginal 95% Student t(19), critical value 2.093024054408263; no multiplicity correction.
analysis.threshold_arithmetic: Recover integer successes over registered exhaustive test pairs (residual <= 1e-8), then use fractions.Fraction for seed means and >= both archived final ACS2/ACS2ER means. First registered point; no interpolation; null if unreached.
diagnostics: terminal unchanged-state draws / unchanged-state relabeled draws
first-action value minus actual discounted return on test: all, successful and failed pairs
objective calls by scoring, selection and provenance, including admissibility
analysis.aggregation: Each cumulative route share divides summed counters within one row, then summarize equally across seeds in both views. Knowledge/population/memory/value diagnostics follow both views; time and cumulative cost also report final totals. Empty conditional groups remain null with contributing seed counts.
analysis.failed_value_diagnostics: Existing rows store all and successful conditional means. Recover the failed group algebraically with the exhaustive integer success/pair counts; empty groups are null. This introduces only binary64 decomposition rounding and adds no evaluation calls or row fields.
analysis.proposals: HER has no rejection stage: proposals equal accepted draws. No separate proposal distribution exists.
analysis.post_hoc: Anything unregistered is labelled post hoc. acs2her_shortened versus acs2her_values_shortened is post hoc only: p differs.
analysis.interpretation: Removing inadmissible goals also increases original-goal fallbacks; comparisons estimate the whole registered rule, not a causal decomposition of overestimation.

identity_checks.seed42: All pilot-overlapping learning, evaluation, knowledge, composition and wall fields agree in binary64 bits; source/hardware and wall times excluded.
identity_checks.references: Verify frozen registrations, complete selected attempts, raw hashes, exact pair assignments and all twenty seeds before analysis.
identity_checks.failure: STOP on mismatch; retain artifacts and charge every attempt.

execution.tooling: experiments/grid; one maze and arm per twenty-seed batch
execution.admission: Before every sbatch derive manifest from approved registration; verify scope membership before accounting, grant and sbatch --test-only; pilot + allocated CPUTimeRAW for every attempt + remaining hard reservations + new limits <= approved cumulative CPU-hour limit.
execution.guards: Clean pinned musl clone ~/acs2-tu; immutable operations snapshots, source/binary/preset/hardware/rows/pilot guards, shared STOP on real failure. No lease, host pinning or laptop dependency.
execution.artifacts: ~/tu_runs/5b/ and ~/Desktop/tu-runs/5b/; pull and independently checksum-verify both copies.
execution.references: Historical reference allocations are reused and reported separately; no new charge or rerun.

forecast.limit_rule: max(3, ceil((2 * seed42 body wall seconds + 60) / 60)) minutes; shared node watchdog retains 30 seconds
forecast.limitation: One seed estimates cost, not future seed growth; all allocations and retries remain charged, with hard admission and STOP.

authorization: Stage 1 only is authorized. The 240-run grid requires user approval of these plan bytes and a cumulative CPU-hour limit.
